docs.title: Glossary
docs.text:
Reads: servers/fastapi/models/sql/*.py, servers/fastapi/templates/v2/**, servers/fastapi/api/middlewares.py, servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/*.py, servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py, servers/fastapi/models/sse_response.py, servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py, servers/nextjs/proxy.ts, start.js · Builds on: Repository tour, Data model · Time: reference, skim as needed

This glossary defines every term that has a precise meaning inside the Presenton code base or inside this book: database columns, JSON keys, template concepts, runtime processes, auth concepts, and the names of streamed events and webhook events. Each entry says what the thing is, where it lives (file and line at snapshot 571461f), and which chapter explains it in depth. Terms are alphabetical; magic keys that start with underscores are sorted by their first letter.

docs.title: Step 1: How the core terms fit together
docs.text:
Most of the vocabulary hangs off one chain: a request produces an outline, the outline is matched to layouts of a template to form a structure, each structure entry becomes a slide whose content is generated against a layout's JSON Schema, and the slide's ui is the template layout with that content applied. Smart mode skips the template chain and stores raw HTML in html_content.

flowchart LR
    REQ["Request: content, files, n_slides"] --> OUT["Outline (PresentationOutlineModel)"]
    TPL["Template v2 row (template_v2)"] --> LAY["layouts: SlideLayout list"]
    LAY --> SCH["json_schema per layout (get_template_schema)"]
    OUT --> STR["Structure: list of layout indexes"]
    SCH --> STR
    STR --> CON["slide.content (LLM fills schema)"]
    CON --> HYD["Asset hydration (__image_prompt__, __icon_query__)"]
    HYD --> UI["slide.ui (layout with content applied)"]
    REQ --> SMART["Smart mode"]
    SMART --> HTML["slide.html_content (layout_group smart-html)"]
    UI --> EXP["Export runtime via /pdf-maker"]
    HTML --> EXP

How to read an entry

The bold-free first line is the term exactly as it appears in code or in this book. The definition gives the meaning, then the source location in inline code, then the chapter. Where two names exist for one thing (for example "block" in the UI and "merged component" in the code), both are listed and cross-referenced.

docs.title: Step 2: Terms A to C
docs.text: Admin A user whose is_superuser is true. Admin-only routes are decided in SessionAuthMiddleware (servers/fastapi/api/middlewares.py:100 to servers/fastapi/api/middlewares.py:114): everything under /api/v1/admin/ and /api/v1/ppt/codex/auth/, POST and DELETE on /api/v1/ppt/fonts/, and five discovery or test paths. An admin must also be using a browser session (method == "jwt"); an admin's API key gets 403 Admin browser session required. See Auth and multi-user. admin_slot A unique, nullable String(32) column on user (servers/fastapi/models/sql/user.py:27). The bootstrap and first-run setup write the value "primary" (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/bootstrap.py:116, servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/router.py:132), so the unique constraint guarantees at most one primary admin. See Auth and multi-user. Alembic migration Schema change scripts in servers/fastapi/alembic/versions/, driven by servers/fastapi/migrations.py. They run at startup unless MIGRATE_DATABASE_ON_STARTUP is set to something other than true or True; the default is "true" (servers/fastapi/migrations.py:41, servers/fastapi/utils/get_env.py:454). Right after migrate_database_on_startup, create_db_and_tables always creates any missing tables (servers/fastapi/api/lifespan.py:57, servers/fastapi/services/database.py:117). See Data model. API key A user-scoped bearer token of the form sk-presenton-<16 hex id>.<secret> (servers/fastapi/services/api_keys.py:19, servers/fastapi/services/api_keys.py:35). The secret must be at least 32 characters (servers/fastapi/services/api_keys.py:58). Default expiry is 90 days, maximum 365 (servers/fastapi/services/api_keys.py:20, servers/fastapi/services/api_keys.py:21). Rows live in api_keys; the full token is stored Fernet-encrypted with a key derived (SHA-256) from the auth secret so an admin can reveal it (servers/fastapi/services/api_keys.py:39). Next.js forwards Bearer sk-presenton-* requests only to FastAPI paths (servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:147). See Auth and multi-user. app_data (APP_DATA_DIRECTORY) The writable data root. start.js refuses to start without APP_DATA_DIRECTORY (start.js:50); the Docker image sets it to /app_data (Dockerfile:82); Python falls back to /tmp/presenton (servers/fastapi/utils/asset_directory_utils.py:24). It holds fastapi.db (default SQLite database, servers/fastapi/utils/db_utils.py:58), userConfig.json, mem0/, and the asset roots images, exports, uploads, pptx-to-html, pptx-to-json (private, per user under users/<owner_id>/) and fonts, templates (shared) (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/assets.py:10 to servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/assets.py:17). URLs under /app_data/ map onto it. See Runtime topology. Asset hydration The step that turns placeholder asset keys in generated slide content into real URLs. process_slide_and_fetch_assets (servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py:173) walks the content for dicts carrying an image prompt or icon query (keys in servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py:22 and servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py:23), generates or searches the asset, and writes image_url/icon_url (template slides) or __image_url__/__icon_url__ (legacy slides) back (servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py:110). process_slide_add_placeholder_assets (servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py:427) fills placeholders first so the UI can render before assets arrive. The result is streamed as slide_assets events. See Images, icons, web search. Async task A row in async_tasks (servers/fastapi/models/sql/async_task.py:16) that tracks background work started by an /async endpoint. Id format task-<64 hex>; status is pending, completed or error (servers/fastapi/enums/async_task_status.py:4); data carries progress and results; payload is hidden from responses (exclude=True). Known type values: presentation.generate (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:137), presentation.smart.generate (servers/fastapi/api/v2/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:39), template.create (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/template.py:100). Polled at GET /api/v1/async-tasks/status/{id}. Tasks left pending by a restart are failed at startup by fail_interrupted_async_tasks. See REST API, async tasks, webhooks, MCP. async_presentation_generation_tasks The older task table (servers/fastapi/models/sql/async_presentation_generation_status.py:13), still created and owner-scoped (servers/fastapi/services/database.py:62). New code writes async_tasks. See Data model. auth_version (av claim) Integer column on user, default 1 (servers/fastapi/models/sql/user.py:43). It is written into every session JWT as the av claim (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/users.py:167) and compared on read by VersionedJWTStrategy (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/users.py:136), so bumping it (password reset, for example) invalidates all existing sessions of that user. See Auth and multi-user. AuthPrincipal (principal) The frozen dataclass describing who is calling: user_id, username, is_admin, and method ("jwt" or "api_key") (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/principal.py:15). resolve_request_principal tries the presenton_session cookie first, then an Authorization: Bearer API key (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/principal.py:22). The middleware stores it at request.state.auth_principal (servers/fastapi/api/middlewares.py:120). See Auth and multi-user. Blank presentation A deck created by POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/create/blank with one empty slide. Its slides use layout_group "blank" (no template) and layout id __blank_slide__, and the ui is a single decorative white 1280 by 720 polygon (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:138 to servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:160). See User journey. Block The UI and chat-tool word for a merged component. POST /api/v1/ppt/template/generate-blocks writes template.merged_components (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/template.py:1906), and the chat tool getAvailableBlocks lists them (servers/fastapi/services/chat/tools.py:186). See Custom templates from PPTX. Chat assistant The in-editor assistant implemented by PresentationChatService (servers/fastapi/services/chat/service.py:74). It runs an LLM tool loop of at most MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS = 40 rounds (servers/fastapi/services/chat/service.py:45), persists turns in chat_history_messages, and streams chunk, status, trace and complete events from POST /api/v1/ppt/chat/message/stream (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/chat.py:124). See Editing and chat assistant. Chat tools The camelCase function tools the chat model may call, defined in ChatTools (servers/fastapi/services/chat/tools.py:84): for example addOutline, addNewSlide, getAvailableLayouts, getContentSchemaFromLayoutId, searchSlide, saveSlide, addElement, addInfographic, addComponent, generateAssets, and for Smart decks getSmartPresentationContext. Their strict input schemas live in servers/fastapi/services/chat/schemas.py. See Editing and chat assistant. Codex (ChatGPT sign-in) The codex LLM provider (servers/fastapi/enums/llm_provider.py:20), which uses a ChatGPT account through an OAuth PKCE flow instead of an API key. The Python port listens for the callback on http://localhost:1455/auth/callback (servers/fastapi/utils/oauth/openai_codex.py:25). Its routes under /api/v1/ppt/codex/auth/ are admin-only. Token fields such as CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN are "OAuth managed" and protected from ordinary settings saves (servers/fastapi/services/provider_settings.py:17). See Configuration and LLM providers. Community designs (community_design_ids) Presentations published to the Presenton community catalog, fetched from https://api.presenton.ai/api/v3/community/presentations (servers/fastapi/services/community_presentations.py:15). A Smart request can name up to 3 of them (MAX_COMMUNITY_REFERENCES), of which at most 6 slides and 90,000 characters are loaded as design references (servers/fastapi/services/community_presentations.py:18 to servers/fastapi/services/community_presentations.py:20). The chosen ids are stored in presentations.community_design_ids (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:79). Enabled by default; disabled when PRESENTON_COMMUNITY_ENABLED is 0, false, no or off (servers/fastapi/utils/get_env.py:32). See Smart mode. Component In Template v2, a named, positioned group of elements inside a slide layout: Component(id, description, position, elements) with at least one element (servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/layouts.py:54). Component ids must be unique within a layout (servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/layouts.py:104). A built-in layout such as the first layout of templates/general/template.json is just an id, a description and a list of components (for example background_canvas, image_showcase_card, right_text_panel). See Template v2 format. CONCURRENT_SERVICE A tiny fire-and-forget scheduler around asyncio tasks with an optional delay (servers/fastapi/services/concurrent_service.py:40). Used, for example, to send webhooks without blocking the response (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:3133). See REST API, async tasks, webhooks, MCP. ConfigurationInitializer The Next.js client component that loads auth status, runtime config, /api/user-config and the Presenton account status into Redux and routes to setup when no provider is configured (servers/nextjs/app/ConfigurationInitializer.tsx). See Settings, onboarding, auth UI. content (presentation) The user's prompt text, a required str column on presentations (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:46), and the content field of GeneratePresentationRequest (servers/fastapi/models/generate_presentation_request.py:9). Not to be confused with slide content. See Standard generation pipeline.

docs.title: Step 3: Terms D to I
docs.text: Decompose Turning uploaded documents into plain text files before generation. POST /api/v1/ppt/files/decompose (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/files.py:133) runs DocumentsLoader (servers/fastapi/services/documents_loader.py:163) over the temp files and returns DecomposedFileInfo items (name, file_path). See Document ingestion. decorative A required boolean on the Template v2 element models that carry content (text, image, text-list, table, chart, infographic; for example servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/elements.py:218). Only elements with decorative: false become fields in the layout's content schema (_is_editable_element, servers/fastapi/templates/v2/schema.py:53); decorative elements are drawn as-is and never rewritten by the LLM. See From template to schema to slide. Default template (built-in template) One of the 16 folders under templates/ (civic to verdant) with a template.json. They are discovered at import time and ordered momentum, dynamic, executive, general, modern, standard, swift first (servers/fastapi/constants/presentation.py:25), then imported into template_v2 with is_default=True on every startup by import_default_templates_on_startup (servers/fastapi/templates/default_templates.py:22). Default rows have owner_id null and are visible to everyone (servers/fastapi/services/database.py:88). The REST default template name is general (servers/fastapi/models/generate_presentation_request.py:30). See Template v2 format. Derive / Edit (presentation) Two one-shot API operations: POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/edit replaces slide content in an existing deck and re-exports it, and POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/derive copies a deck first and then applies the changes (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:3301, servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:3352). Request models are in servers/fastapi/models/presentation_from_template.py. See REST API, async tasks, webhooks, MCP. Desktop guard The Electron-only transport check applied before any auth logic. When PRESENTON_ELECTRON=true, every request must arrive with a Host among PRESENTON_DESKTOP_ORIGINS, a matching Origin if present, and the x-presenton-desktop-token header or presenton_desktop_session cookie equal to PRESENTON_DESKTOP_TOKEN (compared with hmac.compare_digest) (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/desktop.py:25). A token shorter than 32 characters, or no configured origins, yields 503 Desktop session unavailable; a wrong Host or Origin yields 403 Forbidden desktop origin, and a wrong token 401. The same guard exists in servers/nextjs/lib/desktop-auth.ts and the token is minted per launch with 32 random bytes in electron/app/utils/desktop-auth.ts. See Electron desktop app. DISABLE_AUTH Environment flag that turns off login. SessionAuthMiddleware then skips all principal checks and only consults the Presenton Cloud proxy (servers/fastapi/api/middlewares.py:59). Electron runs in this mode, so desktop rows keep owner_id null. See Auth and multi-user. Element The smallest Template v2 drawing unit, a Pydantic model discriminated by type: text, container, image, text-list, table, vector, chart, infographic, flex, grid, group (union SlideElement at servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/elements.py:624). Most carry position, size, rotation and styling; content-bearing ones also carry the schema fields decorative, name, and limits such as max_length/min_length for text (servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/elements.py:217 to servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/elements.py:221). The frontend draws them with Konva. See Template v2 format. export-core (@presenton/export-core) The npm package that actually renders exports. Its version is pinned by presentationExportVersion (v1.0.51) in the root package.json:4, installed into presentation-export/ by scripts/sync-presentation-export.cjs, and invoked through runTask by scripts/run-presentation-export.mjs:116. See PPTX and PDF export. Export runtime The Node child process FastAPI launches for any headless-browser task. ExportTaskService (servers/fastapi/services/export_task_service.py:121) writes a task JSON and runs the runner with task type values export, pptx-to-html, pptx-to-json, html-to-image, html-to-images, json-to-image, json-to-images (servers/fastapi/services/export_task_service.py:439 to servers/fastapi/services/export_task_service.py:692). In Docker the package lives at EXPORT_PACKAGE_ROOT=/app/presentation-export (Dockerfile:84). See PPTX and PDF export. exportCookie / x-export-cookie How the headless export browser authenticates. _build_presentation_export_url puts the caller's cookie header in the URL fragment as exportCookie (servers/fastapi/utils/export_utils.py:36), so it never reaches a server log. The /pdf-maker page reads it and sends it as the x-export-cookie header to /api/export-presentation-data/{id} (servers/nextjs/app/api/export-presentation-data/[id]/route.ts:29). See PPTX and PDF export. FastEmbed The local ONNX embedding library used twice: the icon search vector store (FastembedEmbeddingModel.AllMiniLML6V2 in servers/fastapi/services/icon_finder_service.py:28, cache dir overridable with PRESENTON_FASTEMBED_ICON_CACHE_DIR) and Mem0's default embedder (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, 384 dims, servers/fastapi/services/mem0_oss_memory.py:105 to servers/fastapi/services/mem0_oss_memory.py:109). Weights are pre-downloaded at image build by servers/fastapi/scripts/warm_fastembed_cache.py. See Images, icons, web search. FastMCP The Python framework that turns the committed OpenAPI document into an MCP server (servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py). See MCP. Fonts (presentation fonts, font uploads) Two things. The presentations.fonts JSON column (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:74) maps font family names to stylesheet URLs, for example {"Poppins": "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins..."} as in templates/general/template.json; Smart streams send it as a fonts event. Separately, user-uploaded font files are stored in font_uploads with parsed family, weight and width (servers/fastapi/models/sql/font_upload.py:12), and only admins may upload or delete them. See Themes and fonts. Generation mode (presentation) presentations.generation_mode, either standard or smart (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:75). It decides whether GET /presentation/stream/{id} runs the template pipeline or delegates to stream_smart_presentation (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:2289). See Smart mode. Generation mode (deployment, PRESENTATION_GENERATION_MODE) Deployment switch with values both (default), standard or smart (servers/fastapi/utils/get_env.py:24). It hides UI entry points and decides which MCP tools are exposed (servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py:113). See Smart mode. Generation profile An llmai GenerationProfile that sets default output-token budgets. Presenton reads LLM_GENERATION_PROFILE (default balanced) in get_generation_defaults (servers/fastapi/utils/llm_config.py:189) together with LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS and the LLM_REASONING_* settings. POST /api/v1/ppt/generation/defaults reports the token limits that the profiles BALANCED and MODEL_MAX would produce for a provider and model (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/generation.py:27). See Configuration and LLM providers. generation_metrics (SSE) A Smart-stream event carrying text generation metrics, emitted periodically (SMART_GENERATION_METRICS_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 5.0, servers/fastapi/utils/llm_calls/generate_smart_presentation.py:50) as {"type": "generation_metrics", ...} (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:2169). See Streaming (SSE). html_content Optional text column on slides (servers/fastapi/models/sql/slide.py:27) holding a Smart slide's full HTML section. It is rendered in the browser with the pinned Tailwind and Chart.js runtimes (servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/components/SmartHtmlSlide.tsx). Standard slides leave it null. See Smart mode. Icon query (__icon_query__) The key the slide-content schema uses to ask for an icon by meaning. Accepted spellings are __icon_query__, icon_query and query (servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py:23). Asset hydration resolves it with ICON_FINDER_SERVICE.search_icons (servers/fastapi/services/icon_finder_service.py:179) to a static SVG in the requested icon weight. See Images, icons, web search. Icon weight (icon_type) The Phosphor style used for icons: bold (default), duotone, fill, light, regular, thin (servers/fastapi/utils/icon_weights.py:5 to servers/fastapi/utils/icon_weights.py:10). Stored on the layout model as both icon_type and icon_weight (servers/fastapi/templates/presentation_layout.py:21) and resolved per template by _template_icon_type (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:250). See Images, icons, web search. Image prompt (__image_prompt__) The key the slide-content schema uses to ask for an image. Accepted spellings are __image_prompt__, image_prompt and prompt (servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py:22). The value becomes an ImagePrompt (servers/fastapi/models/image_prompt.py) with optional target width and height taken from the template element (image_target_sizes_from_template, servers/fastapi/utils/process_slides.py:35). See Images, icons, web search. Image provider Where images come from: pexels, pixabay (stock search), gemini_flash, nanobanana_pro, gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5 (hosted generation), comfyui, open_webui, openai_compatible (self-hosted) (servers/fastapi/enums/image_provider.py:4). Dispatch is in ImageGenerationService (servers/fastapi/services/image_generation_service.py:132). See Images, icons, web search. ImageAsset (image library) Table of generated or uploaded images with path, is_uploaded and extras (servers/fastapi/models/sql/image_asset.py:12). There is no explicit __tablename__, so the table is SQLModel's default imageasset (created in servers/fastapi/alembic/versions/00b3c27a13bc_init.py:34). It is read and written by the image endpoints in servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/images.py. See Images, icons, web search. Infographic A Template v2 element type (type: "infographic") with 27 kinds from progress_bar and gauge to org_chart, decision_tree and mind_map (InfographicType, servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/elements.py:427). Defaults and data normalization per kind are in servers/fastapi/utils/infographic_catalog.py. See Editing and chat assistant. instructions Free-text extra guidance from the user, stored on presentations.instructions (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:67) and injected into outline and slide prompts. See Prompts and schemas. is_active / is_superuser (user flags) Boolean columns on the user table (servers/fastapi/models/sql/user.py:31 to servers/fastapi/models/sql/user.py:39). is_superuser is what the rest of the code calls "admin": AuthPrincipal.is_admin is copied from it (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/principal.py:34). See Auth and multi-user.

docs.title: Step 4: Terms L to O
docs.text: Layout (slide layout) One slide design inside a template. In the stored template it is a SlideLayout(id, description, components) (servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/layouts.py:98). For generation it is reduced to a SlideLayoutModel(id, name, description, json_schema) (servers/fastapi/templates/presentation_layout.py:11) by _build_template_layout_model (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:410). On a slide row, slides.layout holds the layout id (servers/fastapi/models/sql/slide.py:24). See From template to schema to slide. Layout (presentation layout column) presentations.layout (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:65) stores a copy of the template's layouts JSON with name, template_id, icon_type and icon_weight added (_copy_template_layout_payload, servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:232). Copying it decouples a deck from later edits to its template. See Data model. Layout group (layout_group) Required string on slides (servers/fastapi/models/sql/slide.py:23) naming the family a slide's layout belongs to. Values in this snapshot: the template id for template slides (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:1815), "blank" for blank decks, and "smart-html" for Smart slides (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:2062). See Data model. LiteParse @llamaindex/liteparse, the Node document parser used for PDFs and other documents. LiteParseService (servers/fastapi/services/liteparse_service.py:67) runs liteparse_runner.mjs with node as a subprocess, with a 600-second default timeout and LITEPARSE_DPI (clamped 72 to 600) and LITEPARSE_NUM_WORKERS settings (servers/fastapi/services/liteparse_service.py:68 to servers/fastapi/services/liteparse_service.py:78). See Document ingestion. llmai The provider-agnostic LLM client library Presenton depends on (llmai==0.3.15 in servers/fastapi/pyproject.toml). It supplies GenerationDefaults, GenerationProfile, prepare_generation and model capabilities (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/generation.py:2). Per-provider client configuration is built in servers/fastapi/utils/llm_config.py. The library source is not part of this repository; its internals are not covered here. See Configuration and LLM providers. LLM provider The selected text model backend, stored in config key LLM. The enum lists 16: ollama, deepseek, openai, google, vertex, azure, bedrock, openrouter, fireworks, together, cerebras, anthropic, litellm, lmstudio, custom, codex (servers/fastapi/enums/llm_provider.py:4). The value presenton (Presenton Cloud) is handled outside this enum by the cloud proxy (servers/fastapi/services/presenton_cloud_proxy.py:439). See Configuration and LLM providers. MAX_NUMBER_OF_SLIDES Hard cap of 50 slides (servers/fastapi/constants/presentation.py:4), enforced on outlines (max_length in servers/fastapi/models/presentation_outline_model.py:27) and on Smart decks (MAX_SMART_SLIDE_COUNT). See Standard generation pipeline. MAX_OUTLINE_WORDS Word limit per outline slide, default 100, read once from the environment at import (servers/fastapi/constants/presentation.py:5 to servers/fastapi/constants/presentation.py:23) and enforced by normalize_outline_content. See Standard generation pipeline. MCP (Model Context Protocol server) A separate process on port 8001 (servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py:431) that exposes a small allowlist of REST routes as tools, renamed to start_standard_presentation, start_smart_presentation, list_templates, upload_template_assets, start_template_generation, upload_files, get_job_status (servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py:101). It is built from the committed openai_spec.json, authenticates with the same API keys (PresentonTokenVerifier, servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py:285), mints a one-hour internal session for upstream calls (servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py:39), and is disabled in Electron (servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py:319). nginx proxies /mcp. See REST API, async tasks, webhooks, MCP. Mem0 The open-source memory layer used to give the chat assistant per-presentation context. Mem0PresentationMemoryService (servers/fastapi/services/mem0_presentation_memory_service.py:18) stores generation context, outlines and slide edits and retrieves at most MEM0_TOP_K (8) memories truncated to MEM0_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS (6000). Storage defaults to <app_data>/mem0 with a local Qdrant path and history.db (servers/fastapi/services/mem0_oss_memory.py:94 to servers/fastapi/services/mem0_oss_memory.py:103). Turned off with MEM0_ENABLED=false, and disabled automatically if the spaCy model (MEM0_SPACY_MODEL, default en_core_web_sm) cannot be loaded, unless MEM0_REQUIRE_SPACY_MODEL=false (servers/fastapi/services/mem0_oss_memory.py:63). See Editing and chat assistant. Merged component A deduplicated component shared across layouts: MergedComponent(id, description, variants) where each variant is a Component (servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/layouts.py:81). Ids must be unique (servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/layouts.py:91). Stored in template_v2.merged_components; the general template has 15. Called "blocks" in the UI. See Template v2 format. nginx auth_request The mechanism that protects files nginx serves directly from disk. Private /app_data/ locations call the internal /_auth_check location, which proxies to FastAPI GET /api/v1/auth/verify with the original cookie and Authorization header (nginx.conf:133 to nginx.conf:142). /app_data/fonts/ and /app_data/templates/ are public. See Runtime topology. Ollama Local model server and LLM provider. start.js can start ollama serve inside the container (start.js:662); /api/v1/ppt/ollama/* lists curated and pulled models and streams pulls, and the pull and "available" routes are admin-only. See Configuration and LLM providers. openai_spec.json A committed, minified OpenAPI document of the FastAPI app (servers/fastapi/openai_spec.json), written by servers/fastapi/scripts/generate_openapi_spec.py and loaded by the MCP server at import (servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py:281). It is not regenerated at runtime. See Endpoint index. Outline The first generation artifact: an ordered list of slide outlines, each a Markdown content string limited to MAX_OUTLINE_WORDS words (SlideOutlineModel, servers/fastapi/models/presentation_outline_model.py:8; PresentationOutlineModel, servers/fastapi/models/presentation_outline_model.py:24). Stored as JSON in presentations.outlines (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:51) and streamed from GET /api/v1/ppt/outlines/stream/{id} (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/outlines.py:84). See Standard generation pipeline. owner_id (owner scoping) Nullable foreign key to user.id with ON DELETE CASCADE on every user-owned table (for example servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:25). It defaults to get_current_owner_id(), a ContextVar set by the middleware for the duration of a request (servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/context.py:5, servers/fastapi/api/middlewares.py:127). Two SQLAlchemy events enforce isolation: do_orm_execute adds owner_id == current to every SELECT on the strict models, and lets template_v2 also match default rows (servers/fastapi/services/database.py:67); before_flush stamps new rows (servers/fastapi/services/database.py:100). The field is excluded from API responses (exclude=True). See Auth and multi-user.

docs.title: Step 5: Terms P to R
docs.text: pdf-maker The Next.js page /pdf-maker?id=<presentation id> (servers/nextjs/app/(export)/pdf-maker/page.tsx) that the export runtime opens in a headless browser. It renders every slide at print size; the export runtime then produces the PDF or PPTX from it. The proxy treats /pdf-maker specially: an exportSession query parameter is turned into a presenton_session cookie and stripped by redirect (servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:114). See PPTX and PDF export. Phosphor icons The icon set bundled with Presenton: servers/fastapi/assets/icons.json declares the set label "Phosphor Icons", and servers/fastapi/static/icons/<weight>/ holds the SVGs (1,512 files in bold/ alone, named like acorn-bold.svg). A missing icon path returns static/icons/placeholder.svg instead of 404 (servers/fastapi/api/main.py:107). See Images, icons, web search. Prepare (presentation) POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/prepare (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:1840): the step after outline editing that resolves the chosen template layout, computes the structure (including TOC slides) and saves both on the presentation, returning only presentation_id. The UI then opens /presentation?id=...&stream=true. See Standard generation pipeline. Presentation version (v1-standard, v2-standard) PresentationVersion enum stored in presentations.version (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:16). v2-standard is every deck created by this snapshot, Standard and Smart alike (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:1747). v1-standard is the value the migration back-fills for decks made before Template v2 (servers/fastapi/alembic/versions/6e4a1b2c3d5f_add_template_v2_and_presentation_version.py:22). The UI refuses to open v1 decks ("This deck was created in an older Presenton version", servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/hooks/usePresentationData.ts:33). See Data model. Presenton Cloud (presenton provider) Optional hosted service at https://api.presenton.ai (servers/fastapi/utils/get_env.py:7). An admin links an account through an OAuth device flow under /api/v1/auth/presenton/*; the encrypted token sits in the presenton_cloud_provider singleton. When provider settings have LLM == "presenton", maybe_proxy_presenton_cloud_request forwards selected generation, edit, Smart and asset paths to the cloud and persists results locally (servers/fastapi/services/presenton_cloud_proxy.py:407). See Configuration and LLM providers. presenton_session The browser session cookie (SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/config.py:11) holding a JWT with a 30-day lifetime (SESSION_TTL_SECONDS, servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/config.py:12). Set by POST /api/v1/auth/login and setup, removed by logout. See Auth and multi-user. properties (slide) Nullable JSON column on slides (servers/fastapi/models/sql/slide.py:29) used by the frontend as a per-item map of image display properties keyed by item index; the updateImageProperties reducer writes slide.properties[itemIndex] (servers/nextjs/store/slices/presentationGeneration.ts:473). The backend copies it but does not interpret it. See Slide editor. Provider settings The provider_settings table, a singleton row with id = 1 and a config JSON blob holding the text, image and web-search provider configuration (servers/fastapi/models/sql/provider_settings.py:10). servers/fastapi/services/provider_settings.py sanitizes, merges and saves it, mirrors it to userConfig.json, and migrates from the file at startup (migrate_provider_settings_from_file, servers/fastapi/services/provider_settings.py:103). Admins edit it through /api/v1/admin/. See Configuration and LLM providers. raw_layouts The intermediate template form produced when a PPTX is converted to JSON by the export runtime: RawSlideLayouts(layouts=[RawSlideLayout(id, description, elements)]) (servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/layouts.py:44, servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/template.py:964). Flat element lists, before component grouping. Stored in template_v2.raw_layouts; null for built-in templates. See Custom templates from PPTX. Redux store The Next.js client state with four reducers: presentationGeneration, pptGenUpload, userConfig, undoRedo (servers/nextjs/store/store.ts:8). See Next.js architecture. Regenerate (Smart) POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/{id}/regenerate (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:1615) deletes all slides of a generated Smart deck so that the next stream generates it from scratch. It refuses non-Smart decks, decks whose can_regenerate is false, and Presenton Cloud (400 Presenton Cloud does not support regeneration). Ordinary SSE reconnects do not reset; they resume from saved slide checkpoints. See Smart mode.

docs.title: Step 6: Terms S
docs.text:
SessionAuthMiddleware The FastAPI middleware that owns authentication (servers/fastapi/api/middlewares.py:29). Order of checks: desktop guard, DISABLE_AUTH short circuit, public paths (/api/v1/auth/status, verify, setup, login, logout, plus /app_data/fonts/ and /app_data/templates/), 428 Login setup is required when no user exists, principal resolution, admin-only rules, owner context, Presenton Cloud proxy, and /app_data ownership. See Auth and multi-user. Slide A row in slides (servers/fastapi/models/sql/slide.py:9): presentation (FK, cascade), layout_group, layout, index, content, html_content, speaker_note, properties, ui, owner_id. See Data model. Slide content (content) The JSON object the LLM produces for one slide by filling the layout's JSON Schema (slides.content, servers/fastapi/models/sql/slide.py:26). It may contain image prompts and icon queries for hydration and the reserved __speaker_note__ key, which is moved to speaker_note (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:2388). For Smart slides it is just {"title": ...} (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:2064). See Prompts and schemas. slides_markdown Optional list on GeneratePresentationRequest (servers/fastapi/models/generate_presentation_request.py:10): one Markdown string per slide, used instead of LLM outline generation. When present it also fixes the slide count (_requested_slide_count, servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:190). See REST API, async tasks, webhooks, MCP. Smart mode / Smart slide The template-free generation path. The LLM writes each slide directly as a 1280 by 720 HTML <section> that is sanitized (no scripts other than vetted Chart.js initializers, no event handlers or javascript: URLs) and stored in html_content with layout_group and layout both "smart-html". Defaults: 8 slides, maximum 50, up to 8 generation attempts (servers/fastapi/utils/llm_calls/generate_smart_presentation.py:45 to servers/fastapi/utils/llm_calls/generate_smart_presentation.py:49). REST entry points are POST /api/v2/ppt/presentation/generate/smart and .../generate/smart/async. See Smart mode. speaker_note Optional text column on slides (servers/fastapi/models/sql/slide.py:28), filled from the __speaker_note__ property that generate_slide_content adds to every slide schema (servers/fastapi/utils/llm_calls/generate_slide_content.py:217). See Prompts and schemas. SSE event names

Every Presenton stream uses the single SSE event name response (servers/fastapi/models/sse_response.py:19); the kind of message is the type field inside the JSON data. The types are listed below.

type Emitted by Payload chunk outlines, Standard stream, chat chunk: text fragment of a JSON document or reply status outlines, Smart stream, chat status: human-readable progress trace chat trace: tool activity object slide_assets Standard stream slide_index, slide, warnings (for example asset_generation_failed) slide_html Smart stream index, slide_id, html, slide fonts Smart stream fonts map generation_metrics Smart stream metrics fields complete all one key: presentation or chat error all, via SSEErrorResponse or safe_sse_stream detail, optional source, status_code, error_type, retryable, completed_slides, total_slides (servers/fastapi/models/sse_response.py:32)

Sources: servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:2362 to servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:2464, servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/chat.py:142 to servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/chat.py:161, servers/fastapi/utils/sse.py:10. See Streaming (SSE).

Standard mode The template-based pipeline: outline, prepare (layout and structure), per-slide content generation, asset hydration, ui hydration, then optional export. See Standard generation pipeline. start.js The container supervisor (start.js). It requires APP_DATA_DIRECTORY, derives userConfig.json from it (start.js:56) and exports USER_CONFIG_PATH (start.js:481), then starts nginx with service nginx start (start.js:698, called at start.js:733) and, alongside it, FastAPI on 8000, Next.js on 3000, the MCP server on 8001 (start.js:46 to start.js:48) and optionally Ollama (start.js:662), waiting until FastAPI, Next.js and nginx are ready (start.js:682). See Runtime topology. Structure The mapping from outline slides to template layouts: PresentationStructureModel(slides: List[int]), a list of layout indexes into the presentation's layout model (servers/fastapi/models/presentation_structure_model.py:5). Chosen by the LLM in generate_presentation_structure unless the layout is ordered, normalized and extended with TOC layouts, and stored in presentations.structure (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:66). See Standard generation pipeline.

docs.title: Step 7: Terms T to Z
docs.text: Table of contents (TOC) Optional generated slides listing the deck's sections, enabled by include_table_of_contents (servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py:70). The number of TOC slides depends on the total (get_no_of_toc_required_for_n_outlines, servers/fastapi/utils/outline_utils.py:52), and the layout is found by regex over layout names (select_toc_or_list_slide_layout_index, servers/fastapi/utils/ppt_utils.py:59). See Standard generation pipeline. Template v2 The current template format and its table template_v2 (servers/fastapi/models/sql/template_v2.py:16): string UUID id, name, description, raw_layouts, components, merged_components, layouts, theme, assets, is_default, owner_id. Built-in template.json files carry id, name, description, thumbnail, merged_components, layouts, fonts, theme. Custom templates are produced from a PPTX by the multi-pass generator in servers/fastapi/templates/v2/generation.py and servers/fastapi/templates/v2/certified_generation.py. A template name of the form custom-<id> is accepted and stripped to <id> (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:200). See Template v2 format. Template schema (get_template_schema) The JSON Schema derived from a template layout that the LLM must fill, built by get_template_schema (servers/fastapi/templates/v2/schema.py:257) from the non-decorative elements of each component, with table text capacity and repeated-group arrays handled specially. See From template to schema to slide. Temp files Uploaded documents live in owner-scoped temporary directories managed by TEMP_FILE_SERVICE (servers/fastapi/services/temp_file_service.py:191), rooted at TEMP_DIRECTORY or, when unset, /tmp/presenton (servers/fastapi/services/temp_file_service.py:14); the Docker image sets TEMP_DIRECTORY=/tmp/presenton (Dockerfile:83). See Document ingestion. Theme Colors and fonts for a presentation: PresentationThemeData with colors (PresentationThemeColors: roles primary, background, card, stroke, background_text, primary_text, graph_0 to graph_9) and fonts.textFont (name, url) (servers/fastapi/models/theme_data.py:4, servers/fastapi/models/theme_data.py:31). Template themes are derived from layout colors by servers/fastapi/templates/v2/theme.py (LLM or deterministic role selection with contrast repair). Stored in presentations.theme and template_v2.theme. See Themes and fonts. Tone and verbosity Writing-style knobs on generation requests. Tone: default, casual, professional, funny, educational, sales_pitch (servers/fastapi/enums/tone.py). Verbosity: concise, standard, text-heavy (servers/fastapi/enums/verbosity.py). See Prompts and schemas. ui (slide) Nullable JSON column on slides (servers/fastapi/models/sql/slide.py:30): the fully materialized Template v2 layout for this slide, that is the layout object (id, description, components, optionally background and elements) with the slide content applied to its non-decorative elements. Built by _template_slide_ui plus _apply_template_content_to_ui (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:490, servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:575) and edited directly by the Konva editor. templateV2UiToHtml turns it into 1280 by 720 HTML (servers/nextjs/lib/template-v2-json-to-html.ts:156). See From template to schema to slide. Undo history The editor keeps at most MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES = 50 states (servers/nextjs/components/slide-editor/model/core.ts:20) in the undoRedo slice. See Slide editor. userConfig.json The JSON configuration file at USER_CONFIG_PATH (in Docker, <APP_DATA_DIRECTORY>/userConfig.json, start.js:56). It is seeded from environment variables by start.js and scripts/user-config-env.cjs, read into the process environment on every request by UserConfigEnvUpdateMiddleware (servers/fastapi/api/middlewares.py:23), and written with a .lock file and a .bak backup (servers/fastapi/utils/user_config_store.py:17 to servers/fastapi/utils/user_config_store.py:22). Identical locking code exists in Next.js and Electron. When Next.js returns it to the browser, secrets are replaced by __configured__ (servers/nextjs/lib/runtime-provider-config.ts:6). See Configuration and LLM providers. Web search provider How outlines get fresh facts: auto, native (the LLM provider's built-in search), searxng, tavily, exa, brave, serper (servers/fastapi/enums/web_search_provider.py:4). Routing is in servers/fastapi/utils/web_search.py. Enabled per request by web_search. See Images, icons, web search. Webhook / webhook events Subscriptions in webhook_subscriptions (webhook-<hex> id, url, secret, event) created by POST /api/v1/webhook/subscribe. Two events exist: presentation.generation.completed and presentation.generation.failed (servers/fastapi/enums/webhook_event.py:5). WebhookService.send_webhook POSTs the JSON body (the PresentationPathAndEditPath on success, an APIErrorModel on failure) to every matching subscription with Authorization: Bearer <secret> when a secret is set, and only prints errors (servers/fastapi/services/webhook_service.py:12). See REST API, async tasks, webhooks, MCP.

docs.title: Gotchas collected from the glossary
docs.text:
Gotcha

trigger_webhook exists on GeneratePresentationRequest (servers/fastapi/models/generate_presentation_request.py:44) but nothing in the FastAPI code reads it. The success and failure webhooks are scheduled unconditionally in generate_presentation_handler (servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:3133, servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py:3150); filtering happens only by subscription event.

Gotcha

"Layout" means three different things: a template SlideLayout (components), a generation SlideLayoutModel (id plus JSON Schema), and the presentations.layout column (a copied template payload). The slides.layout column is only the layout id string. Read the type, not the name.

Gotcha

presenton is a valid value of the LLM setting but not a member of LLMProvider (servers/fastapi/enums/llm_provider.py:4). get_llm_provider answers 500 Invalid LLM provider for it (servers/fastapi/utils/llm_provider.py:47), so any request that reaches local LLM code instead of being intercepted by the cloud proxy fails. When you add a route that calls the LLM, check whether it also needs a cloud proxy rule.

Gotcha

owner_id is null in two very different situations: built-in templates (shared with everyone because is_default is true) and every row created in auth-disabled mode, including Electron. If you turn auth on for a database created with DISABLE_AUTH, those rows are not visible to any user until ownership is backfilled (the bootstrap's legacy backfill in servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/bootstrap.py exists for this reason).

Gotcha

All SSE messages share the event name response. A client that registers addEventListener("chunk", ...) receives nothing; it must listen for response and switch on data.type.

docs.title: What you now know
docs.text:
• The vocabulary of the data model: presentation, slide, content, ui, html_content, properties, layout_group, version, owner_id.
  • The Template v2 hierarchy from element to component to layout to template, and where decorative, merged components ("blocks") and raw layouts fit.
  • The runtime pieces by name: start.js, the export runtime and export-core, /pdf-maker, the MCP server, LiteParse, FastEmbed, Mem0, llmai.
  • The auth terms: principal, API key format, presenton_session, auth_version, admin, desktop guard, DISABLE_AUTH.
  • The names of every SSE message type, async task type and webhook event.
